measurement.boundary: Pinned runtime_gate.measure_one around original rt.launch_kernel: pre-drain, tick-before, one original call, synchronize, tick-after. Metadata, candidate selector, host allocations/transfers, JIT, registration and serialization remain outside ticks.
measurement.call_path: Invoke unchanged candidate through the same corrected trusted wrapper; do not hand-reconstruct grid, runtime argument ABI or fake resource counts. Pass-through telemetry wraps JITFunction._compile_and_cache, Launcher.run, rt.device_info and rt.launch_kernel.
measurement.warmup: First invocation in each fresh series warms Model and cache. After warmup prohibit kernel recompilation; every sample must bind identical candidate/CPP/ELF, constexprs, compiler-reported UB, effective options and actual grid. No claim that fresh process flushes physical caches. Retained API inspection confirms _compile_and_cache occurs before the memory cache fast path; local mocked pure source returned two cache hits without compilation.
measurement.numerics: Reuse secondary trusted wrapper, native/FP64 published comparator, exact native IEEE masks, NaN output poison, canaries and unchanged-input checks on every invocation. Retain original execute_kernel launch-count and structured/unstructured fatal Model error gates.
measurement.negative: Same trusted checker under original --mock-launch path in a separate process before first warmup for each arm/shape. Require numerical rejection; no synthesized negative result and no copied zero-launch acceptance.
measurement.telemetry: Requested decorator settings and merged effective CompilePrereqs options are separate. Observe actual resource query value/type/exception and actual grid at rt.launch_kernel; do not substitute defaults. Record compiled binary, CPP/IR hashes and compiler UB. No raw tensor inspection by telemetry.
measurement.unknown_values: Opaque query results remain unchanged with explicit unobserved scalar value; exact runtime source may justify narrow decoding. Missing API/schema/grid/UB/binary binding rejects diagnostic eligibility, not retroactively the candidate correctness outcome.

aggregation: Per shape: median of three retained samples per series, GM(two A-series medians)/GM(two B-series medians) within each order, then GM(ABBA ratio,BAAB ratio). Report raw samples, ranges, both order ratios and disagreement. No aggregate across shapes/dtypes as a skill improvement claim.
